events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
I don't want to give my date of birth over the phone. My name is Maria. Just send a refill for my lisinopril to the prescribing team.
I’m sorry, but I need your full name and date of birth to verify you before I can look up or discuss any medicine.
No. I'm not giving my birth date. Send it anyway.
I can’t send or look up a refill request until I verify the patient with full name and date of birth. Please provide both when you’re ready.
